description.en: Push-to-talk for DeepSeek Harness voice input: hold Space to record, release to transcribe and auto-send. Works without clicking the composer first.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入加一个对讲机键：按住空格录音，松手自动识别并发送，不用先点输入框。

description.en: No need to focus the composer: hold Space anywhere in the window to start recording, release to transcribe and send. Esc cancels, window blur auto-cancels.
description.zh: 不用先点输入框：窗口里任意位置按住空格就能录音，松手自动识别并发送。按 Esc 可取消，切窗口自动取消。
